create.name: Diana Beaulieu
create.bio:
Diana Beaulieu is a teacher of womb-centred energy work and the founder of the InnerWomb Method and Sacred Woman Awakening. She studied biology and human sciences at Oxford University and took a postgraduate degree in environmental anthropology at UCL, then worked as an anthropologist in Latin America and as a researcher and writer for charities, NGOs and universities. She went on to spend around ten years training in, practising and teaching Shiatsu, worked in frontline women's and homelessness services, and completed a seven-year apprenticeship in core shamanic practice. She has also performed traditional goddess stories at the British Museum.

Her InnerWomb Method treats the womb as an energetic centre of intuition, creativity and feminine power, whether or not a woman has a physical womb. Her teaching combines breathwork, shamanic journeying, energy clearing, soul retrieval and meditation, with a strong focus on relationships, boundaries and creative purpose. She teaches online courses, runs a three-level certified practitioner training with students in more than forty countries, offers mentoring for practitioners, and hosts the Womb 2 Womb podcast. She also teaches self-paced courses on The Shift Network.

flags: Every paid offering was dropped under the health-claim rule (see left_out), so the page would have videos only. A human may prefer to skip her or to accept one offering with a rewritten description.
Her work centres on 'womb healing' and trauma; the bio and video descriptions were written to avoid trauma-treatment claims, but the subject matter is borderline throughout.

Email: support@sacredwomanawakening.com is published on the practitioner-training page; the contact page (a form) asks people to whitelist info@sacredwomancoaching.com, and admin@ and training@sacredwomanawakening.com also appear on other pages.
Shift bio says she is a published author, but no book by her was found (a 2023 interview says she is writing one).
Location not published (older pages mention Ibiza, prices are in EUR); availability set to worldwide.
Womb of the Earth Wisdom Messages were recorded as monthly messages (March 2023 etc.) but their titles are undated; kept, could be dropped.
Global Peace Meditation description mentions clearing ancestral memories 'stored in your DNA'; kept as it names no condition.
left_out: The Energetic Imprints of Sexual Trauma (Shift professional training, $1,799 USD): trauma in title.
Reclaiming Your Womb Power (Shift self-paced, $297 USD): page promises to 'clear trauma' and 'heal residual or past pain in your womb', with period-pain testimonials.
Sacred Womb Healing online course (€397): page says it may heal womb-related traumas after disease or surgery in the reproductive system.
Womb Activation & Healing 3-week course (€37): page mentions money anxiety and menstrual issues (borderline).
InnerWomb Method Practitioner Training (next cohort 7 Apr 2027) and its free webinar: billed as 'The Missing Piece in Women's Trauma Healing'.
Medicine Woman 1-1 coaching (€4,888): one-to-one, not her main way of working.
Free PDF '7 Signs You Need Womb Healing': borderline, left out.

Videos left out: Earth Oracle monthly readings (dated 2023), Dare to Dive Deeper, Distorted & Disempowering Feminine Archetypes, Sin Eaters (descriptions mention trauma, abuse or depression), sexual-healing, child sexual abuse and slavery-imprint meditations, Fear Detox, Ancestral Healing Ceremony (dated 2020), I am the Goddess (song), practitioner-training intro (promo).
